decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet builds directly on the firm's formulation know-how and its strategy of differentiated combination products, and it has its own page, so the firm can interpret its early results and develop it further.

A generic antidepressant capsule fits squarely within the firm's existing manufacturing and regulatory knowledge, and the dedicated page shows it is actively marketed, even though generic price pressure carries some risk.

The combination antihypertensive line with several models relies on the firm's core formulation and transfer capabilities, and it represents a sizeable investment that management will keep and build on.

The bone and joint supplement fits the strategy of pharmacy-exclusive health products, but it is only mentioned on the website, so it has less visibility and draws less on the firm's pharmaceutical knowledge, which raises the risk of a drop.
